label: input token o at original position >= 4
explanation: Fires whenever the input token is the letter o during the original (pre-<DEL>) phase at position 4 or later; it is silent for o at positions 0-3. Precision 1.0 on dev: every such step is active. Magnitude grows steadily with position: per-step activation mass at t=8 is about 4x that at t=4, so the largest activations are o as the last token of a length-9 sequence. It does not fire on any other token, never on the delimiter, and almost never in the copy phase (31 tiny activations on o echoed as an input in the copy phase). It fires on repeated o as well as the first o.

issues: Minor factual slip: the explanation says dev has 31 tiny copy-phase activations. The profile shows 26 copy-phase active steps on dev (test has 25 misses). Either way they hold about 0% of the mass. Most are a faint echo, about 0.02-0.04 of max, on o fed back in the copy phase, and one is on p. This is scattered noise, not a systematic class.

All other claims hold. Test precision is 1.0, recall 0.9994 and mass recall 0.99997, with 0 false positives. o at t<4 never fires (66372 predicted, precision 0). Activation per step at t=8 is about 4.2x that at t=4 ((0.118/2796) / (0.139/13965)). Repeated o fires with precision 1.0 (6871 steps). The delimiter and other tokens are silent apart from single stray steps.
